entry_criteria: Sterling Grid V6: HMA pivot + (UC rising OR MACD cross-up)
exit_criteria: ExD compound exit + tiered profit lock
market_context_summary: GDP tracking +2.3% with Feb payrolls at -92K and unemployment rising to 4.4%. Fed held at 3.50-3.75% with median dot projecting one cut in 2026. Iran conflict driving oil above $108 and VIX to 26.78. S&P 500 breadth near capitulation with only 12.7% above 20-day MA. Small caps outperforming SPY by +4pp YTD as the Great Rotation from mega-cap tech into value and cyclicals continues.

themes.name: Sovereign Satellite ISR
themes.thesis_summary: Sovereign demand for real-time satellite intelligence is structurally increasing as the Iran conflict, European rearmament, and Indo-Pacific tensions drive governments to build independent ISR capabilities. EOCL and allied programmes represent a $4B+ IDIQ with multi-year contract visibility.
themes.why_now: Iran conflict has elevated demand for space-based ISR. Gen-3 satellite technology achieving commercial parity with legacy systems at fraction of cost. $345M backlog growing 32% YoY.
key_catalysts: Gen-3 constellation 8-9 on orbit by year-end 2026

themes.name: Copper Structural Deficit
themes.thesis_summary: ICSG projects persistent copper deficits through the decade. Demand drivers are structural: EVs, grid modernisation, data centre build-out, and defence electronics all require copper. New mine supply takes 10+ years to develop. Producers with near-term production growth trade at premiums.
themes.why_now: Florence Copper commenced production March 2026 (first greenfield US copper in a decade). Copper at $6/lb near multi-year highs. Supply constrained with limited new projects.

themes.name: AI Semiconductor Fab Optimization
themes.thesis_summary: The transition from FinFET to gate-all-around architecture multiplies simulation demand. CHIPS Act fab construction requires full EDA tool stacks. Silvaco holds the #2 global TCAD position and is acquiring semiconductor IP assets at distressed multiples while the rest of the EDA sector trades at 11-16x revenue.
themes.why_now: Q4 2025 earnings beat by 57%. Cost cuts 70% executed. CEO/CFO cluster buy at all-time low. SIP revenue doubled in 5 months via Mixel acquisition.
primary_risks: $10M unrestricted cash creates genuine binary risk
TCAD declining -25% vs Synopsys vertical integration

themes.name: Bispecific Antibody AD Pipeline
themes.thesis_summary: TSLP-targeting biologics for atopic dermatitis represent the next frontier after Dupixent's $13B franchise faces patent cliff anxiety. ACRS has both biologic (bosakitug, ATI-052) and oral (ATI-2138, ATI-9494) programs spanning the two most sought-after target classes. Multi-shot structure reduces all-fail probability to ~17%.
themes.why_now: Bosakitug Phase 2 enrollment completed March 18 (109 patients). ATI-052 Phase 1a interim data showed 4x potency. $59.8M institutional raise from specialist healthcare funds at current prices.
primary_risks: TSLP may not translate from asthma to skin disease
Correlated failure risk on 2 of 4 programs

themes.name: Rare Disease M&A Target
themes.thesis_summary: CPRX is the highest-quality balance sheet in small/mid-cap pharma: 36% net margins, $709M cash, zero debt, $200M buyback active. FIRDAPSE and AGAMREE franchises growing 20%+ annually. But FIRDAPSE (61% of revenue) faces active patent litigation with March 2026 trial.
themes.why_now: FIRDAPSE patent trial imminent. Outcome determines whether CPRX is a $35 stock or a $15 stock. Wait for resolution before deploying.
primary_risks: FIRDAPSE patent loss would expose 61% of revenue to generic erosion
All products in-licensed with no proprietary pipeline

themes.name: DC Immersion Cooling
themes.thesis_summary: Accelsius (INV subsidiary) has genuine technology differentiation with the NeuCool two-phase cooling platform. But INV's holding company structure, serial dilution, and governance issues destroy the risk/reward for equity holders. Smart money is investing in Accelsius directly ($65M Series B from Johnson Controls).
themes.why_now: NeuCool IR150 launched at NVIDIA GTC March 16. But INV stock down 61% from highs despite the tailwind.
primary_risks: INV holding company structure = structural value trap

themes.name: Coal Geopolitical Repricing
themes.thesis_summary: BTU and CNR ride geopolitical energy tailwinds but lack structural force alignment. Both exceed $2B market cap. Coal is a cyclical trade, not a secular theme for our system.
themes.why_now: Iran conflict driving energy prices. But this is a macro trade, not our system's edge.
